title: fix: align Azure model pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Sets Azure public pricing to 0.75×, except GPT-5.6 Sol at 1/3×; exact provider costs remain separate.
- Raises Terra from 0.625× to 0.75× and lowers Luna from 1× to 0.75×; both remain 25% below OpenRouter standard. Sol output matches OpenRouter standard while input/cache remain cheaper.
- Corrects GPT Audio 1.5 Global provider cost from $40/$80 to the account-billed $32/$64 per million audio input/output tokens.
- Corrects grok-large advertised context from 1M to the selected Azure route maximum of 200K. Direct probes accepted 199,005 prompt tokens and rejected a 200,193-token request. No xAI-direct 200K+ cost variant is added because this Azure route cannot enter that tier and Azure publishes only flat Grok meters.
- Restores the GPT-5.6 quest-access regression guard and preserves routes, aliases, fallbacks, and paidOnly behavior.

Evidence: [Azure Retail Prices](https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices); [Azure Grok 4.3 catalog](https://ai.azure.com/catalog/models/grok-4.3); [xAI pricing](https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing); [OpenRouter Sol endpoints](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-5.6-sol/endpoints).

Tests: 399 focused Enter pricing/access/catalog tests; 70 Gen catalog/permission tests; direct Azure boundary probes; Biome.

gist.headline: The price tags got audited
gist.blurb: Polli took a tiny clipboard to the Azure model shelf. The labels now match the meters, including a less imaginary Grok context window.
gist.summary: Aligned advertised Azure pricing to 0.75× public pricing for most models, set GPT-5.6 Sol to one-third pricing, corrected GPT Audio 1.5 Global costs to $32/$64 per million audio input/output tokens, and set grok-large context to Azure's 200K-token route limit.
gist.impact: Developers now get Azure model prices and grok-large context metadata that match the selected Azure routes, while GPT-5.6 quest access and existing aliases, fallbacks, and paidOnly behavior remain intact.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden has carefully corrected price tags beside Azure-blue cloud-shaped planters and a retro terminal showing a 200K context gauge. Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor and holding a clipboard, checks the labels while code-plants bloom; the scene represents accurate public prices and route-specific model limits.
